property_summary: After withdrawFees(asset, recipient) completes, c.unclaimedFees(asset) must be zero for every admissible asset (reference clears it); the mutant stores fees back so any asset with accrued fees keeps a nonzero balance after withdrawal.
change_summary: Replace `unclaimedFees[asset] = 0;` with `unclaimedFees[asset] = fees;` so the balance is doubled instead of cleared.
